claim: NOAA publishes annual versioned Storm Events bulk files
evidence_summary: Annual details filenames contain event year and creation date
conclusion_or_follow_up: Store snapshots and select latest imported revision

claim: NOAA tornado dimensions can refer to a segment
evidence_summary: Descriptions explicitly allow tornado or tornado segment
limitations: Source record count is not a count of unique tornadoes
conclusion_or_follow_up: Keep source records separate from curated exhibits

claim: NOAA bulk format guide has a suspect EF wind table
evidence_summary: Table labels categories EF but gives values inconsistent with current NWS EF guidance
limitations: This does not establish that the underlying category records are wrong
conclusion_or_follow_up: Do not derive wind speed from that table

claim: EF categories are damage-based wind estimates
evidence_summary: Explains estimated three-second gusts and EF category ranges
limitations: Category does not establish actual measured wind or funnel appearance
conclusion_or_follow_up: Keep rating separate from measured wind and visual dimensions

claim: JMA catalogue includes several kinds of gust phenomena
evidence_summary: Code 1 is tornado and other codes include downburst and uncertain combinations
limitations: Current catalogue has not been normalized by this project
conclusion_or_follow_up: Build dedicated classification and sentinel handling

claim: JMA content reuse requires attribution and labeling modifications
evidence_summary: Identifies public data terms attribution and modification notices
limitations: Exceptions apply and linked full public data terms need publication review
conclusion_or_follow_up: Review applicable terms and media rights before publication

claim: International Fujita ratings should retain their original scale
evidence_summary: Discusses differences in wind definitions and handling of older ratings
limitations: Not a universal conversion table between scales
conclusion_or_follow_up: Preserve F EF IF JEF and TORRO identities

claim: El Reno has substantial official material for a possible exhibit
source_title: May 31 2013 tornado and flash flood event
evidence_summary: Provides event chronology maps and discussion of radar and damage
limitations: Appearance reconstruction and photograph rights remain unreviewed
conclusion_or_follow_up: First geographic exhibit implemented using published KMZ; shot registration still needed

claim: Northern Eurasia has a research catalogue spanning historical records
source_title: Tornadoes in Northern Eurasia From the Middle Age to the Information Era
evidence_summary: Potential source for former USSR region and historical uncertainty
limitations: Full article access returned 403 and dataset reuse not checked
conclusion_or_follow_up: Locate accessible authorized data and verify terms before import

claim: NWS El Reno KMZ contains timed center positions
evidence_summary: 39 point labels plus one path and one polygon; XML time order needs sorting
limitations: No per-position error bounds supplied; AM/PM and time zone inferred from accompanying chronology
conclusion_or_follow_up: Preserve original bytes and geographic sequences; show discrete positions

claim: A caption differs from the final rating description
access_level: description partial captions and sampled stills
evidence_summary: Caption says EF5 while current description says EF3
limitations: Caption text was read; audio was not independently checked
conclusion_or_follow_up: Use final official rating; review historical correction context

claim: Swegle glowing tornado video covers Blackwell 1955
source_title: The Night a Tornado Started Glowing
limitations: No full video review or physical mechanism validation
conclusion_or_follow_up: Pair with historical accounts and the TornadoTRX lead

claim: El Reno end times differ across source components
source_title: El Reno event account and tornado table
access_level: full text and local NCEI record
locator: event narrative versus tabulated end time
evidence_summary: Narrative gives 6:42 PM CDT; table and NCEI 453682 give equivalent of 6:44 PM CDT
conclusion_or_follow_up: Retain both endings; geographic timeline ends at its final 6:42 label

claim: NWS distinguishes government data from licensed third-party imagery
locator: Use of NOAA/NWS Data and Products; mapping data
evidence_summary: Original government data generally public domain; third-party material may differ
limitations: Do not imply endorsement or label modifications as official
conclusion_or_follow_up: Attribute original geometry and label this independent adaptation
